subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps for Acme Commerce
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Darren Cole <darren.cole@acme-commerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & stakeholder mapping from today's discovery call

Hi Darren —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Thought I'd capture the key notes and ask for a quick favor on stakeholder mapping so we can align next steps.

Recap from our call (top-line):
- Primary use case: customer support triage and summarized case notes for faster resolution.
- Estimated volume: ~1.2M tokens/month initially, spike days during Black Friday prep.
- Key constraints: PII handling requirements, EU data residency for EU customers, and low 95th percentile latency for agent-assist flows.

What I need to move this forward on our end:
1) Org chart or short list of decision-makers for procurement, legal/security, and the economic buyer (who signs off on budget).
2) Any procurement timelines or PO process we should account for.
3) Contact for security/compliance questionnaire (SOC 2 / data handling) so we can start the evidence pull.

If you can share an org chart or point people to loop in, that'll help us put together a mutual action plan (MAP) tailored to those stakeholders. I attached a one-page template we use for MAPs to give you a sense of deliverables and timelines.

Proposed next steps:
- You share stakeholder list/org chart by end of week (Fri 7/17)
- I'll draft a MAP and bring in Rishi (solutions engineer) for a technical alignment session the following week

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if that's easier for mapping names.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: ACME-MAP-Template.xlsx (1 page)
From: Darren Cole <darren.cole@acme-commerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Ruiz <s.ruiz@acme-commerce.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 15:24:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up & stakeholder mapping from today's discovery call

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. Helpful. I'm attaching an org chart and a draft of the procurement timeline we typically follow. Quick notes inline:

- Economic buyer: Samantha Ruiz (SVP Product Ops) — final approval on tooling spend.
- Legal/Security: I can introduce you to our security lead but for now copy procurement@acme-commerce.com for questionnaire intake.
- Procurement lead: Miguel Alvarez (m.alvarez@acme-commerce.com) handles SOWs/POs and vendor onboarding.

Sharing the two attachments: acme_org_chart.pdf (internal) and ACME-MAP-2026.xlsx (procurement draft).

We aim to have vendor decisions by the end of August; procurement typically needs 3–4 weeks from SOW to PO once legal signs off.

I'll loop in Miguel and the security contact in my next email to make introductions unless you'd like to make the intro.

Cheers,
Darren
Head of Customer Support — Acme Commerce

Attachment: acme_org_chart.pdf, ACME-MAP-2026.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Darren Cole <darren.cole@acme-commerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & stakeholder mapping from today's discovery call

Thanks Darren — that's exactly what we needed.

Quick next asks so we can draft a MAP that speaks to each stakeholder:
- Can you confirm Samantha's preferred evaluation criteria? (e.g., cost per ticket, % SLA uplift, integration effort, legal risk tolerance)
- Please provide the name/email for the security contact (even if it's a group alias) and Miguel's best contact (if different).
- If there are any existing vendor controls or assessment templates you use with security (e.g., SIG, CAIQ), please share — we can pre-fill what we can to speed review.

Rishi and Dev are on this thread and will own:
- Rishi: technical alignment session and demo tailored to support workflows
- Dev: procurement pack (SOW template and pricing options) and will draft the proposal once we have stakeholder confirmation

Suggested timeline:
- EOW (7/17): Acme provides stakeholder names + any assessment templates
- Week of 7/20: 30–45 min technical alignment with Rishi; Dev to share initial SOW draft
- Week of 7/27: Legal/security deep-dive and procurement kickoff

If it helps, I can send a one-pager for Samantha that highlights decision criteria tied to business outcomes (cost per ticket, time-to-resolution, CSAT impact). Would you like that?

Best,
Marissa

Marissa / Rishi / Dev —

Looping in Miguel (procurement) and security alias. Miguel — I'll defer to you for SOW/PO cadence, but our internal target is to complete vendor selection by 08/31.

Samantha's top evaluation criteria are:
1) Total cost of ownership (first-year + run rate)
2) Minimal integration effort (pre-built connectors to Zendesk)
3) Reliability/uptime guarantees and support model for enterprise customers
4) Security posture and quickness of completing a SIG questionnaire

Security alias: they can start with the CAIQ we typically request; I'll circulate any internal docs if needed.

Miguel: happy to schedule a short intro next week — what times work for you?

Thanks,
Darren
